title: Cucumber Moped Bot
tagline: Cross-chain Telegram trading bot you can trade any token across 9 EVM networks with
description: Trade any token across 9 EVM chains on top of Telegram. Our bot allows users to send both market and limit orders that are gasless, MEV protected and cost efficient. Besides standard features all trading bots have such as depositing, withdrawing and swapping our bot has myriad of additional features. For example, you can invest in systematic strategies, earn Blockscout Merits by trading and view token price charts.
how_its_made: Cross-chain market orders are sent using 1inch Fusion+ while market orders on the same chain are sent using 1inch Fusion. Limit orders utilize 1inch limit order protocol. Wallet and asset data is fetched using Blockscout SDK. The most active users that complete personhood verification with World ID are rewarded with Blockscout Merits from their activity. Furthermore, users can choose to invest in systematics strategies, whose computationally heavy calculations are aggregated using Hedera.
